posts.title: The story of OnlineOTP
posts.description: A few months ago I faced an annoying problem. I wanted to redeem my Cathay Pacific Miles but I was unable to log into my account. The SMS OTP never arrived. My account was tied to my Sri Lankan number, which I’ve had for many years, yet I never received their OTP. posts.title: When Life gives you Jenga
posts.description: A month ago I bought a box of Jenga. I played it the way it was intended a grand total of two times. You can have a lot of fun with solid, uniformly weight distributed identical blocks. 😁 Life is like Jenga. You start off thinking there's a right way to do things. posts.title: Delegate Results not Tasks
posts.description: I’ve had the opportunity and privilege of leading teams for 8+ years.
